data.title: Warehouse Group reports FY26 operating profit recovery
data.description:
Warehouse Group ( (NZ:WHS) ) has provided an update.

At its 2026 annual meeting, the group reported FY26 sales of $3,027.6m, down 1.9% on the 53-week FY25, while comparable 52-week sales fell 0.2% and same-store sales rose 0.4%. Operating profit increased to $22.6m from $1.3m as gross margin rose to 32.6% and cost of doing business fell 3.0%.

Free cash flow was $79.4m and net debt declined by $79.1m to $17.0m, while the group increased investment in its store network. Noel Leeming and Warehouse Stationery delivered stronger returns, but the company said The Warehouse remained below an acceptable profitability level and was its most important recovery priority; no final dividend was declared for FY26.

data.title: Fab-Form Reports USPTO Allowance for SPACE-R Patent Claims
data.description:
Fab-Form ( (TSE:FBF) ) has provided an announcement.

Fab-Form Industries Ltd., a Vancouver, British Columbia-based manufacturer of eco-friendly concrete forming products, develops foundation products for the building industry and has traded on the TSX Venture Exchange under FBF since 2000. The company announced that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office has allowed patent claims for SPACE-R, its concrete-column reinforcement product, describing the allowance as a milestone.

SPACE-R replaces a traditional horizontal steel stirrup with a lightweight fiberglass component, uses polypropylene clips to connect vertical rebar, and has polypropylene fins to position reinforcement in column forms. The company says the design reduces shipping costs and onsite labor while addressing corrosion and installation-error concerns, and that it works with contractors’ existing formwork and Fab-Form’s Fast-Tube fabric form.

data.title: NiobiumX Describes Shipshaw Niobium Exploration Methodology
data.description:
Arctic Fox Ventures ( (TSE:NIOX) ) just unveiled an announcement.

NiobiumX described an exploration methodology combining airborne magnetic data, ground radiometric data, structural mapping and machine learning. The approach focuses on magnetic lows, thorium highs and geological structures associated with carbonatite systems that can host niobium mineralization.

Historical drilling tested 23 holes in the northern part of the Shipshaw magnetic low, intersecting carbonatite in 21, while the centre of the anomaly remains undrilled. The release says machine learning will compare Shipshaw’s geophysical characteristics with the nearby Saint-Honoré complex and help rank areas for drilling and assay.

data.title: G5 Board Proposes Approximately SEK 84.3 Million Voluntary Redemption Programme
data.description:
G5 Entertainment AB ( (SE:G5EN) ) has issued an announcement.

G5 Entertainment operates in the games industry and distributes games through its G5 Store. The board proposed a voluntary redemption programme for up to 1,053,892 ordinary shares, approximately 14.3% of those outstanding, at SEK 80 per share and a maximum total of approximately SEK 84.3 million.

Under the proposed structure, each ordinary share would carry one redemption right, with seven rights required to redeem one share; trading in rights and redemption shares is to be arranged on Nasdaq Stockholm. Shareholders who do not participate may sell their rights or retain their holdings, while unused rights lapse without value.

The board also proposed cancelling 300,000 own shares and combining this with a bonus issue so share capital remains unchanged; ongoing share repurchases have been paused pending the programme. The release says cost savings implemented during 2026 have left the group profitable and that it has no liabilities other than lease liabilities.

data.title: Scott Technology shareholders approve five annual meeting resolutions
data.description:
Scott Technology Limited ( (NZ:SCT) ) just unveiled an update.

At Scott Technology Limited’s 26 November 2026 annual meeting, shareholders passed five ordinary resolutions by poll, re-electing Stuart McLauchlan and Alan Byers and electing Jerson Nascimento Jr. as directors. data.title: Arsan Agrees to Sell Armadaş Natural Gas Distribution Stake
data.description:
An announcement from Arsan Holding A.S. ( (TR:ARSAN) ) is now available.

Arsan Holding A.S. is identified as a shareholder in Armadaş Arsan Maraş Doğalgaz Dağıtım A.Ş., whose field of activity is natural gas distribution.

On November 26, 2026, Arsan signed an agreement to sell its entire 39.096% stake to Koni Teknik Mühendislik A.Ş., a wholly owned subsidiary of Aksa Doğalgaz Dağıtım A.Ş. The transaction is subject to legal permits, approvals and other agreed conditions; if completed, Arsan’s participation relationship will end and its ownership will fall to zero, while the price and any resulting profit will be determined at closing.

data.title: Rottenstone Gold Proposes Great Bear Royalty Acquisition
data.description:
An update from 79 Resources Ltd ( (TSE:SK) ) is now available.

Rottenstone Gold is proposing to acquire a 0.75% net smelter return royalty over certain Great Bear Project lease areas and associated exploration claims, some situated in Ontario and operated by Kinross Gold through Great Bear Resources. Subject to disinterested shareholder and CSE approval, the company would issue 18,064,516 shares at $0.155 each as non-cash consideration valued at $2,800,000.

The supplemental disclosure, issued at the request of Ontario Securities Commission staff, addresses details of the proposed related-party transaction and MI 61-101 requirements. An independent valuation dated August 7, 2026 placed the royalty’s fair market value at $2,400,000 to $2,800,000, while shareholders are scheduled to vote on December 7, 2026.

data.title: Klabater Adopts Share Issue Linked to Defence.Hub Gaming-Business Contribution
data.description:
An announcement from Klabater S.A. ( (PL:DFH) ) is now available.

Defence.Hub S.A. is a Warsaw-based issuer, while Klabater P.S.A. is its wholly owned Warsaw-based subsidiary. The transaction concerns the issuer’s organised GAMING segment, comprising tangible and intangible assets intended for gaming activities.

On 26 November 2026, Klabater’s Extraordinary General Meeting resolved to issue 300,000 new ordinary Series B shares at PLN 1.00 each, offered entirely to Defence.Hub. Defence.Hub agreed to subscribe for all the shares and undertook to transfer the segment as a non-cash contribution; the issue and articles amendment will become effective upon registration, and the issuer said the information could significantly affect its results and financial position.
